hero.heading: Bitcoin Stories, Ideas & Experiences
hero.subheading: A community-driven publication featuring essays, insights, and experiences from graduates of the Pan-Africa Bitcoin Academy — exploring the future of Bitcoin in Africa and beyond.

pre_education_box.title: Pre-Education Ideas
pre_education_box.body:
Are you curious about Bitcoin but haven't started learning yet?
Share your thoughts, questions, or ideas about Bitcoin as you see it today.
pre_education_box.reward_note: Thoughtful and well-explained contributions will receive a sats reward.

pre-education.name: Pre-Education Ideas
pre-education.description: Thoughts, questions, and ideas from people curious about Bitcoin before starting their education journey. Share what you're thinking about Bitcoin, what questions you have, or what you hope to learn.

essays.name: Student Essays
essays.description: Personal reflections and essays from students exploring how Bitcoin has changed their thinking, what sovereignty means to them, and their learning journeys.

community.name: Community Stories
community.description: Real-world stories about using Bitcoin in daily life, teaching family and friends, building local communities, and sharing Bitcoin with others.

africa.name: Bitcoin in Africa
africa.description: Articles exploring Bitcoin's role, potential, and impact across Africa—from adoption stories to economic empowerment and sovereignty.

technical.name: Technical Deep Dives
technical.description: In-depth technical articles exploring Bitcoin protocol details, cryptography, consensus mechanisms, and advanced technical concepts.

lightning.name: Lightning Experiments
lightning.description: Experiments, tutorials, and experiences with Lightning Network—from first payments to building Lightning applications and exploring its potential.

future.name: Ideas for the Future
future.description: Visionary articles about the future of Bitcoin in Africa, development ideas, community visions, and forward-thinking perspectives.

beginner.name: Beginner Lessons
beginner.description: Educational content designed for beginners—clear explanations of Bitcoin basics, step-by-step guides, and foundational concepts.

reflections.name: Reflections & Opinions
reflections.description: Personal reflections, opinions, and philosophical discussions about Bitcoin, sovereignty, economics, and the broader implications of decentralized money.

builders.name: Builder Showcases
builders.description: Showcases of Bitcoin projects, tools, and applications built by students and community members—from wallets to educational resources.

projects.name: Graduation Projects
projects.description: Final projects from academy graduates—comprehensive work demonstrating mastery of Bitcoin concepts, technical skills, and real-world applications.

write_for_us.heading: Write for Us
write_for_us.subheading: Want to publish your Bitcoin story?
write_for_us.body: If you're a graduate of the academy, mentor, or community member, we invite you to share your ideas, experiences, and insights.
